40003968.author: पदार्थः
40003968.content: धर्मे in virtues, स्थिता abiding, सुमित्रा Sumitra, तथा then, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, प्रमदोत्तमाम् best among women, तां कौशल्याम् to that Kausalya, धर्म्यम् conforming to righteousness, इदं वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40003968.author: Translation
40003968.content: While Kausalya, the best of women was thus lamenting, virtuous Sumitra spoke to her these righteous words:

40003969.author: पदार्थः
40003969.content: आर्ये O venerable one, सद्गुणैः with every good quality, युक्तः endowed with, तव your, सः पुत्रः such a son, पुरुषोत्तमः the greatest among men, एवम् in this way, ते you, विलपितेन with lamentation, कृपणम् bitterly, रुदितेन वा or by weeping, किम् what is the use?

40003969.author: Translation
40003969.content: My venerable lady, your son Rama is the greatest among men and is endowed with every virtue. Why do you lament in this way? Why do you weep bitterly?

40003970.author: पदार्थः
40003970.content: आर्ये O noble lady, महाबलः mighty, यः Rama, तव पुत्रः your son, महात्मानम्   magnanimous, पितरम् father, साधु worthy of, सत्यवादिनम् as truthful one, कुर्वन् to do, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, शिष्टैः by virtuous men, सम्यक् fully, शश्वत्  everlasting, आचरिते followed, प्रेत्य in the next world, फलोदये at the time of fruition, धर्मे in virtues, स्थितः stuck, श्रेष्ठः best, सः that, रामः Rama, कदाचन at any point, शोच्यः न  not to be grieved over.

40003970.author: Translation
40003970.content: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.

40003971.author: पदार्थः
40003971.content: आर्ये O noble lady, महाबलः mighty, यः Rama, तव पुत्रः your son, महात्मानम्   magnanimous, पितरम् father, साधु worthy of, सत्यवादिनम् as truthful one, कुर्वन् to do, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, शिष्टैः by virtuous men, सम्यक् fully, शश्वत्  everlasting, आचरिते followed, प्रेत्य in the next world, फलोदये at the time of fruition, धर्मे in virtues, स्थितः stuck, श्रेष्ठः best, सः that, रामः Rama, कदाचन at any point, शोच्यः न  not to be grieved over.

40003971.author: Translation
40003971.content: In order to vindicate the words of his great and truthful father, O noble lady,your mighty son has renounced the kingdom and has gone (to the forest). He has stuck to the path so scrupulously followed by the wise, the everlasting results of which can be fully realised in the world to come. Such a peerless son is never to be grieved over.

40003972.author: पदार्थः
40003972.content: अनघः blameless one, सर्वभूतेषु in all creatures, दयावान् compassionate, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अस्मिन् in the matter (of Rama), सदा always, उत्तमाम् highest, वृत्तिम् conduct, वर्तते doing(showing), महात्मनः great soul, तस्य to him, लाभः is benefit.

40003972.author: Translation
40003972.content: Blameless Lakshmana, compassionate to all beings, has acted most nobly in this matter for the benefit of his great soul.

40003973.author: पदार्थः
40003973.content: सुखोचिता used to comforts, वैदेही Sita, अरण्यवासे living in the forest, यत् दुःखम् those hardships, जानती वै knowingly, धर्मात्मानम् virtuous, तव your, आत्मजम् son, अनुगच्छति is following.

40003973.author: Translation
40003973.content: The daughter of Videha (Sita) who was used to comforts has knowingly followed your virtuous son into the hardships of forest life.

40003974.author: पदार्थः
40003974.content: प्रभुः competent, यः who, कीर्तिभूताम् renowned, पताकाम् the banner, लोके in this world, भ्रमयति waving, धर्मसत्यव्रतधनः one who considers righteousness and truth as wealth, तव आत्मजः your son, किम् what, न प्राप्तः did not gain.

40003974.author: Translation
40003974.content: Your allcompetent son who considers righteousness and truth as wealth, is waving  the flag of fame in this world. What is that which your son did not gain ?

40003975.author: पदार्थः
40003975.content: रामस्य Rama's, शौचम् purity, उत्तमम् excellent, माहात्म्यम् greatness, विज्ञाय having known, सूर्यः sun, अंशुभिः with rays, गात्रम् body, सन्तापयितुम् to torment, न अर्हति will not be inclined,  व्यक्तम् this is evident.

40003975.author: Translation
40003975.content: Knowing Rama's sterling purity and greatness the Sun evidently dare not scorch his body with its rays.

40003976.author: पदार्थः
40003976.content: शिवः gracious, काननेभ्यः from the woodlands, विनिस्सृतः blowing out, युक्तशीतोष्णः with moderate heat and cold, सुखः pleasant, अनिलः breeze, राघवम् of Rama, सर्वेषु कालेषु at all seasons, सेविष्यति will attend.

40003976.author: Translation
40003976.content: A pleasant yet moderately hot and cold breeze blowing through the woodlands will serve Rama at all seasons.

40003977.author: पदार्थः
40003977.content: चन्द्रमा the Moon, रात्रौ at night, अनघं sinless man, शयानम् while asleep, शीतैः cool, रश्मिभिः with rays, संस्पृशन् while touching, पितेव like father, अभिपरिष्वजन् while embracing, आह्लादयिष्यति delight.

40003977.author: Translation
40003977.content: While that sinless Rama sleeps at night, the Moon will comfort him by touching him with cool beams like a father embracing his son.

40003978.author: पदार्थः
40003978.content: रणे in war, दानवेन्द्रम् lord of demons, तिमिध्वजसुतम् Timidhwaja's son, हतम् having been killed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महौजसे having great lustre, यस्मै to that Rama, ब्रह्मा like second Bramha, (Viswamitra), दिव्यानि divine, अस्त्राणि weapons, ददौ gave, शूरः brave, पुरुषव्याघ्रः best of men, सः that Rama, अरण्यस्थोऽपि though staying in the forest, स्वबाहुबलम् with the strength of his arms, आश्रितः taking refuge, असन्त्रस्तः without fear, वेश्मनीव like in his own palace, निवत्स्यति will reside.

40003978.author: Translation
40003978.content: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.

40003979.author: पदार्थः
40003979.content: रणे in war, दानवेन्द्रम् lord of demons, तिमिध्वजसुतम् Timidhwaja's son, हतम् having been killed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महौजसे having great lustre, यस्मै to that Rama, ब्रह्मा like second Bramha, (Viswamitra), दिव्यानि divine, अस्त्राणि weapons, ददौ gave, शूरः brave, पुरुषव्याघ्रः best of men, सः that Rama, अरण्यस्थोऽपि though staying in the forest, स्वबाहुबलम् with the strength of his arms, आश्रितः taking refuge, असन्त्रस्तः without fear, वेश्मनीव like in his own palace, निवत्स्यति will reside.

40003979.author: Translation
40003979.content: To the mighty, heroic Rama, that best of men, Brahmalike Viswamitra has bequeathed many divine weapons, seeing him slay Timidhwaja's son (Subahu), lord of demons, in the battle. He will stay fearless in the forest, relying on the strength of his own arms as though he were living in the palace.

40003980.author: पदार्थः
40003980.content: यस्य whose, इषुपथम् range of arrows, आसाद्य having received, शत्रवः enemies, विनाशम्  destruction, यान्ति will meet, तस्य such Rama's, शासने in the command, पृथिवी earth, कथम् how, स्थातुम् to subordinate, नार्हति is unfit.

40003980.author: Translation
40003980.content: When enemies who are targets of his arrows are destoyed, how can this earth, not stay under the command of Rama?

40003981.author: पदार्थः
40003981.content: रामस्य Rama's, या श्रीः that splendour, शौर्यं च valour, या कल्याणसत्वता that auspicious  strength, निवृत्तारण्यवासः having returned from forest life, सः that Rama, क्षिप्रम्  quickly, (स्वं) राज्यम् his kingdom, अवाप्स्यति will regain.

40003981.author: Translation
40003981.content: On return from his sojourn in the forest, Rama, endowed with splendour, valour and a strength that brings wellbeing will quickly regain his kingdom.

40003982.author: पदार्थः
40003982.content: देवि O Devi (Kusalya), सूर्यस्यापि for the sun, सूर्यः भवेत् he will act as light of the Sun, अग्नेः for fire, अग्निः lustre of fire, प्रभोः for a ruler, प्रभुः as supreme ruler, श्रियश्च prosperity, श्रीः as prosperity, कीर्त्याः for fame, अग्र्या as supreme, कीर्तिः fame, क्षमा for tolerance, क्षमा as tolerance, दैवतानाम् for gods, दैवतम् as god, भूतानाम् for all beings, भूतसत्तमः as supreme being, भवेत् shall be, तस्य for such Rama, वने वापि even in forest, अथवा or, पुरे or in town, अगुणाः demerits, के हि where are they?.

40003982.author: Translation
40003982.content: O Devi Rama is the Sun (light) of the Sun, fire (splendour) of the fire, master (command) of masters, prosperity of the prosperous, the fame of the famous, forbearance of the forbearing, god of the gods and supreme among all beings. Whether he dwells in the forest or in the city, he has no demerit whatsoever.

40003983.author: पदार्थः
40003983.content: देवि O Devi (Kusalya), सूर्यस्यापि for the sun, सूर्यः भवेत् he will act as light of the Sun, अग्नेः for fire, अग्निः lustre of fire, प्रभोः for a ruler, प्रभुः as supreme ruler, श्रियश्च prosperity, श्रीः as prosperity, कीर्त्याः for fame, अग्र्या as supreme, कीर्तिः fame, क्षमा for tolerance, क्षमा as tolerance, दैवतानाम् for gods, दैवतम् as god, भूतानाम् for all beings, भूतसत्तमः as supreme being, भवेत् shall be, तस्य for such Rama, वने वापि even in forest, अथवा or, पुरे or in town, अगुणाः demerits, के हि where are they?.

40003983.author: Translation
40003983.content: O Devi Rama is the Sun (light) of the Sun, fire (splendour) of the fire, master (command) of masters, prosperity of the prosperous, the fame of the famous, forbearance of the forbearing, god of the gods and supreme among all beings. Whether he dwells in the forest or in the city, he has no demerit whatsoever.

40003984.author: पदार्थः
40003984.content: पुरुषर्षभः eminent among men, रामः Rama, पृथिव्या सह with earth, वैदेह्य along with Sita, श्रिया च with the goddess of fortune, एताभिः with these, तिसृभिः सह with three, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अभिषेक्षयते will be consecrated.

40003984.author: Translation
40003984.content: Rama, the best among men, will soon be coronated with these three namely the earth, the goddess of fortune and Sita.

40003985.author: पदार्थः
40003985.content: निष्क्रामन्तम् when he was leaving, यम् whom, उदीक्ष्य having seen, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, सर्वे all, जनाः inhabitants, शोकवेगसमाहताः whipped by the speed of sorrow, दुःखजम्  caused by sorrow, अस्रम् tears, विसृजन्ति are shedding, कुशचीरधरम् clad in bark and kusa robes, गच्छन्तम् departing, अपराजितम् the unconquerable, देवम् divine one, लक्ष्मीः goddess of fortune, सीतेव like Sita, अनुगता has followed, तस्य to him, किं नाम what, दुर्लभम् is difficult?

40003985.author: Translation
40003985.content: When the people of Ayodhya saw the godlike Rama departing, clad in robes of kusha and bark, they were moved to tears of grief. What is impossible for him who is unconquerable and whom Sita, like the goddess of fortune, follows.

40003986.author: पदार्थः
40003986.content: निष्क्रामन्तम् when he was leaving, यम् whom, उदीक्ष्य having seen, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, सर्वे all, जनाः inhabitants, शोकवेगसमाहताः whipped by the speed of sorrow, दुःखजम्  caused by sorrow, अस्रम् tears, विसृजन्ति are shedding, कुशचीरधरम् clad in bark and kusa robes, गच्छन्तम् departing, अपराजितम् the unconquerable, देवम् divine one, लक्ष्मीः goddess of fortune, सीतेव like Sita, अनुगता has followed, तस्य to him, किं नाम what, दुर्लभम् is difficult?

40003986.author: Translation
40003986.content: When the people of Ayodhya saw the godlike Rama departing, clad in robes of kusha and bark, they were moved to tears of grief. What is impossible for him who is unconquerable and whom Sita, like the goddess of fortune, follows.

40003987.author: पदार्थः
40003987.content: धनुर्ग्रहवरः the most skilled archer, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, स्वयम् himself, बाणखड्गास्त्रभृत् bearing arrows, swords and other weapons, यस्य to whom, अग्रे in the forefront, व्रजति going, तस्य for that Rama, किं नाम what, दुर्लभम् is the difficulty?

40003987.author: Translation
40003987.content: What is impossible for Rama ahead of whom moves Lakshmana, the best of archers, weilding swords, arrows and other weapons?

40003988.author: पदार्थः
40003988.content: देवि O Kausalya, निवृत्तवनवासम् on completion of exile, पुनः again, आगतम् having returned, तम् that Rama, द्रष्टासि will see, शोकं च sorrow, मोहं च delusion, जहि you may give up, ते  to you, सत्यम् truth, ब्रवीमि am telling.

40003988.author: Translation
40003988.content: I tell you the truth, Kausalya, that you will see Rama's return when the period of exile is complete. Hence give up your sorrow and delusion.

40003989.author: पदार्थः
40003989.content: अनिन्दिते irreproachable one, कल्याणि O auspicious one, एतौ चरणौ at these feet, शिरसा with head, वन्दमानम् paying homage, पुत्रम् son, उदितम् rising, चन्द्रमिव Moonlike, पुनः again, द्रक्षयसि will see.

40003989.author: Translation
40003989.content: O irreproachable and auspicious one you will see your son, like the rising Moon, touching your feet with his head.

40003990.author: पदार्थः
40003990.content: पुनः again, प्रविष्टम् having entered, अभिषिक्तम् enthroned, महाश्रियम् shining in glory, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्षिप्रम् soon, नेत्राभ्याम् from your eyes, अनन्दजम् arising out of joy, पयः water, समुत्स्रक्ष्यसि pour out.

40003990.author: Translation
40003990.content: Soon you will see him enthrouned shining in full glory on his return from exile while tears of joy will flow from your eyes.

40003991.author: पदार्थः
40003991.content: देवि O Devi (Kausalya) शोकः grief, दुःखं वा or distress, मा do not entertain, रामे in Rama, अशिवम् inauspiciousness, न दृश्यते is not to be seen, त्वम् you, ससीतम् with Sita, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, पुत्रम् son, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्षयसि you will see.

40003991.author: Translation
40003991.content: Desist from grief or tear for Rama, O Devi nothing inauspicious will happen to him you will soon see your son along with Sita and Lakshmana.

40003992.author: पदार्थः
40003992.content: अनघे sinless lady, देवि O Devi शेषः the remaining, जनः people, त्वया by you, यदा when, समाश्वास्यः एव are to be consoled, इदानीम् in this manner, हृदि in your heart, विक्लबम्  overcome with fear, करोषि doing, इदम् this, किम् what?

40003992.author: Translation
40003992.content: O sinless lady, O queen when you are overcome by fear, how can you console others?

40003993.author: पदार्थः
40003993.content: देवि O Kausalya, यस्याः whose, ते to you, राघवः Rama, सुतः as son, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to          grieve, नार्हा are not fit, रामात् compared to Rama, परः superior, सत्पथे on the path of virtue, स्थितः abiding, लोके in this world, न विद्यते हि is not found.

40003993.author: Translation
40003993.content: O Kausalya,  with a son like Rama, you should not grieve. There is none in this world superior to Rama who stands steady in the path of virtue.

40003994.author: पदार्थः
40003994.content: अभिवादयमानम् one while bowing to you in reverence, ससुहृदम् along with friends, तं सुतम् to your son, दृष्ट्वा seeing, क्षिप्रम् soon, वार्षिकी pertaining to rainyseason, मेघलेखेव like a streak of clouds, मुदा delightfully, अश्रु tears, मोक्ष्यसे you are going to shed.

40003994.author: Translation
40003994.content: Like a flake of cloud in monsoon, you are going to shed tears of joy soon seeing your son along with his friends bowing to you in reverence.

40003995.author: पदार्थः
40003995.content: वरदः one who confers boons, ते पुत्रः your son, क्षिप्रम् soon, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, पुनः again, आगतः having returned, मृदुपीनाभ्याम् tender and plump, पाणिभ्याम् hands, चरणौ your feet, पीडयिष्यति will press.

40003995.author: Translation
40003995.content: Your son, bestower of boons, will soon return to Ayodhya and press your feet with his soft, tender hands.

40003996.author: पदार्थः
40003996.content: अभिवाद्य greeting, नमस्यन्तम् offering salutations, शूरम् brave ससुहृदम् with friends, सुतम् to your son, मुदा with delight, अस्रैः with tears, मेघराजिः mass of clouds, अचलमिव like a mountain, पुनः again, प्रोक्ष्यसि will be drenched.

40003996.author: Translation
40003996.content: While paying obeisance to you, you will drench your brave son, surrounded by friends, with tears of joy like a mass of clouds drenching the mountain.

40003997.author: पदार्थः
40003997.content: वाक्योपचारे serving with words, कुशला skilled, अनवद्या irreproachable, रामा cheerful nature, देवी queen, सुमित्रा Sumitra, विविधैः various, वाक्यैः words, आश्वासयन्ती while consoling, रामस्य Rama's, तां मातरम् to his mother, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, विरराम fell silent.

40003997.author: Translation
40003997.content: Irreproachable and skilful in the use of words, queen Sumitra of cheerful disposition fell silent after thus consoling Rama's mother in various ways.

40003998.author: पदार्थः
40003998.content: तत् that, लक्ष्मणमातृवाक्यम् words of Lakshmana's mother, निशम्य having heard, नरदेवपत्न्या: queen, रामस्य मातुः of Rama's mother, शोकः grief, शरद्गतः relating to autumn, अल्पतोयः with slight moisture, मेघ इव like cloud, सद्यः instantly, शरीरे in the body, विननाश destroyed.

40003998.author: Translation
40003998.content: On hearing the words of Lakshmana's mother the grief in the heart of the queen (Kausalya), mother of Rama, instantly disappeared like the autumnal cloud that holds but little rain. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
